import unittest
from card_summary import summarize

class CardSummary(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_drop_complete_words_and_count_placeholder(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize('Atlas harbor crane', 12), 'Atlas...')
        self.assertEqual(summarize('Atlas harbor crane', 15), 'Atlas harbor...')
        self.assertEqual(summarize('longword', 4), '...')
        self.assertEqual(summarize('longword', 3), '...')

    def test_whitespace_is_collapsed_before_length_check(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize('  Atlas\t\n harbor  ', 12), 'Atlas harbor')
        self.assertEqual(summarize('Atlas\t harbor crane', 15), 'Atlas harbor...')
        self.assertEqual(summarize(' \t\n ', 3), '')

    def test_full_text_fits(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize('dock', 4), 'dock')
        self.assertEqual(summarize('Atlas', 20), 'Atlas')
        self.assertEqual(summarize('', 3), '')

    def test_default_hyphen_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize('Atlas-harbor crane', 12), 'Atlas-...')
        self.assertEqual(summarize('Atlas-harbor crane', 15), 'Atlas-harbor...')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
